title: ENHANCEMENT SHAMAN

source.author: NickTew
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Shaman Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: A smooth leveler with some of the highest beta damage: front-load spells for the mp5 rule, then melee.

build.early: Levels 1-20: Thundering Strikes 5, Mental Dexterity 3, Improved Ghost Wolf 2 (or 2 in Improved Lightning Shield and respec at 20, when you learn Ghost Wolf), Shamanistic Focus 1. Legacy points: the extra five go to Improved Stormstrike, Spirit Weapons, Flurry and Mental Quickness.

why.Mental Dexterity: Intellect becomes attack power (half as much as Strength).
why.Improved Ghost Wolf: Use Ghost Wolf indoors; no damage, but you will not want to play without it.
why.Ancestral Knowledge: A point to reach the next tier.
why.Improved Stormstrike: Less damage but big mana regeneration.

core.t: Your main melee strike; slowest weapon is best once you have it.
Pull with it; save the shock cooldown against dangerous casters.
Drop it right after pulling, ideally still out of range.
On more than 2 targets, or when you need the damage now.

items.t: on cooldown to kick or damage

notes: Use the mp5 rule: mana regenerates 5 seconds after your last spell, so front-load your casts and then just melee. Spend freely if you want more damage at the cost of mana efficiency.
Keep Flametongue Weapon up (Rockbiter makes a tank's life harder; some mobs resist fire). At level 30 use Windfury Weapon.
Strength of Earth Totem is weak at low level but cheap with 30 yards of range: pre-place it before packs or a boss.
Totemic Projection moves your totems, but has a 1 minute cooldown: use it sparingly.
Mana potions are underrated for uptime.

stats.t: 2 attack power per point: your best stat.
1 attack power per point, plus spell crit and a bigger mana pool.
Crit for attacks and spells, a bit less efficient per point.
Helps mp5; only trade for it at 5+ Spirit for 1 point of something else.
Weak: Shaman spells scale at about 1/5 of other classes.

gear: Weapon: any two-hander with as much damage as possible. Once you have Stormstrike, take the slowest weapon you can find.
If you tank, use a shield and a good one-hander; otherwise a shield is not worth it.
Level 20 consumables: Longjaw Mud Snapper (10 AP, 5% XP), Elixir of Ogre Strength, Elixir of Lesser Agility, Elixir of Wisdom, Heavy Sharpening Stone and Heavy Weightstone.

dungeon_gear.items: Forsaken Greataxe (Ruins of Lordaeron quest) · Hammerbone (Wailing Caverns: Leaders of the Fang quest) · Smite's Mighty Hammer (The Deadmines, Alliance).

dungeon_tips: Fire Nova on 3+ targets is one of the best spells in the game, but mana-hungry: if you cannot drink, spend mana on Fire Nova first.
Use Earth Shock only for casts that must be kicked, such as Fear or Healing Touch.
Tremor Totem ticks every 4 seconds: drop it as the Fear lands, not before.

alliance.note: The only Alliance option: Stoneform, Mace Specialization and Big Game Hunter.

horde.note: Best raw DPS: Blood Fury, Axe Specialization, Shatter Curse and Hardiness.
Berserking is decent and Rapid Regeneration heals; Regeneration is basically useless.
War Stomp is a nice utility stun; Plainsrunning does not stack with Ghost Wolf.
Wind Blessed, Skysight, Walk on Air: all around underwhelming.

races.pick: Orc > Troll > Tauren > Skyborne for raw damage; Dwarf is the only Alliance option.

professions.note: Mana Well campfire buff: the best option for mp5.
Lodestone campfire buff: melee attack power.
Fish Bowl campfire buff: 8% to all stats.
The tent gives 5% rested XP: use it on cooldown.
